## Working in a repository

- Before you change anything in a repository, read its own instructions,
  named above, and follow them. For work in that repository they come first:
  its AGENTS.md, branch and review rules, checks and tracker take precedence
  over this file.
- Run Git, build and test commands in that repository's checkout: set the
  shell tool's working directory to it rather than changing directory in the
  command. This workspace is not a repository, so every branch, commit and
  pull request belongs to one of the checkouts.
- Record the work in the tracker named for its repository. A fleet can use
  more than one tracker; never move work between them on your own.
- Keep each repository's files in its own checkout. Do not copy them, or its
  instructions, here or into another repository.
